nodes.description: Constant state variable: 86400 seconds representing one day, used for day-based release calculations.
Immutable state variable holding the IERC20 token held by the timelock contract.
Immutable state variable holding the beneficiary address that receives released tokens.
Immutable state variable: start timestamp of the token release period, rounded down to a day boundary.
Mutable state variable: end timestamp of the token release period, updated on terminate().
Mutable state variable: total amount of benefit available to the beneficiary, reduced on terminate().
Mutable state variable: amount already withdrawn by the beneficiary, updated in withdraw().
Boolean state variable flagging whether the contract has been terminated.
Private state variable from Ownable holding the contract owner address.
SupervisedTimelock constructor: sets token, beneficiary, release start/end times, total benefit and checks release end time against block.timestamp.
Public withdraw(): computes newly released amount, updates _withdrawedBalance and transfers tokens to the beneficiary via safeTransfer.
Owner-only terminate(): reduces _totalBenefit to released balance, resets _releaseEndTime, sets termination flag and transfers remaining tokens to owner.
View function computing the vested balance based on block.timestamp relative to the release period.
View function returning _totalBenefit minus releasedBalance().
View function returning _withdrawedBalance.
View function returning the held IERC20 token.
View function returning the beneficiary address.
View function returning _totalBenefit.
Modifier requiring _isTerminated == false before executing the guarded function.
Modifier requiring owner() == _msgSender() to restrict access to owner-only functions.
Context helper returning msg.sender.
Private Ownable function updating _owner and emitting OwnershipTransferred.
View function returning _owner.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks via _msgSender().
Miner/validator-controlled current timestamp driving release scheduling and termination time logic.
External token transfer token().safeTransfer(_beneficiary, amount) inside withdraw(), an outbound call that can invoke untrusted token code.
External token transfer token().safeTransfer(owner(), amountToWithdraw) inside terminate().
Arithmetic subtraction token().balanceOf(address(this)) - (_totalBenefit - _withdrawedBalance) in terminate(), potential underflow path.
Constructor parameter for the IERC20 token address.
Constructor parameter for the beneficiary address.
Constructor parameter for the release start timestamp.
Constructor parameter for the number of timelock days.
Constructor parameter for the total benefit amount.
Parameter of transferOwnership() naming the new owner address.
Local variable in withdraw(): releasedBalance() - _withdrawedBalance.
Local variable in releasedBalance(): (block.timestamp - _releaseStartTime) / SECONDS_OF_A_DAY.
Local variable in releasedBalance(): (_releaseEndTime - _releaseStartTime) / SECONDS_OF_A_DAY.
Local variable in terminate(): token balance minus the remaining unreleased benefit.
Local variable in _setOwner() caching the previous owner address.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter token_ is assigned to state variable _token.
Constructor parameter beneficiary_ is assigned to state variable _beneficiary.
Constructor parameter releaseStartTime_ is day-truncated and assigned to _releaseStartTime.
releaseStartTime_ is used to compute _releaseEndTime.
daysOfTimelock_ multiplied by SECONDS_OF_A_DAY contributes to _releaseEndTime.
Constructor parameter totalBenefit_ is assigned to _totalBenefit.
block.timestamp is compared with _releaseEndTime in the constructor require, making initialization time dependent.
releasedBalance() branches on block.timestamp to decide how much benefit is vested, a timestamp dependency.
withdraw() reads releasedBalance() to compute the withdrawable amount.
withdraw() reads _withdrawedBalance to compute the delta amount.
withdraw() updates _withdrawedBalance with the withdrawn amount.
Local variable amount is derived from releasedBalance().
The computed amount is passed to safeTransfer as the transfer value.
_beneficiary is used as the recipient of the token transfer in withdraw().
terminate() uses block.timestamp to reset the release end time, a timestamp dependency.
terminate() sets _totalBenefit from releasedBalance().
terminate() overwrites _totalBenefit with the currently released balance.
terminate() overwrites _releaseEndTime with the current day boundary.
terminate() sets the _isTerminated flag to true.
_totalBenefit participates in the subtraction computed inside terminate(), an arithmetic operation that can underflow.
_withdrawedBalance participates in the subtraction computed inside terminate(), an arithmetic operation that can underflow.
The subtraction result is stored in local variable amountToWithdraw.
amountToWithdraw is passed to safeTransfer to the owner in terminate().
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
_msgSender() returns msg.sender directly.
onlyOwner compares the caller-derived msg.sender against the owner, an access control decision on untrusted input.
onlyOwner reads owner() for the authorization check.
transferOwnership passes newOwner into _setOwner.
_setOwner assigns the new owner to _owner.
_setOwner caches the previous _owner into oldOwner.
isNotTerminated reads _isTerminated to enforce that the guarded function has not been terminated.
unreleasedBalance() subtracts releasedBalance() from the total benefit.
unreleasedBalance() reads _totalBenefit as the minuend.
withdrawedBalance() returns the _withdrawedBalance state variable.
totalBenefit() returns the _totalBenefit state variable.
token() returns the _token state variable.
beneficiary() returns the _beneficiary state variable.
Constructor calls _msgSender() to initialize the owner.
onlyOwner calls _msgSender() to resolve the caller.
terminate() is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier restricting who may terminate the contract.
terminate() is guarded by isNotTerminated preventing repeated termination.
withdraw() performs an external token transfer, transferring control to the token contract.
terminate() performs an external token transfer to the owner.
The external safeTransfer call in withdraw() can re-enter withdraw() before the caller's state is fully settled.
The external safeTransfer call in terminate() can re-enter the contract's functions via malicious token code.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter token_ is only used by the constructor to initialize _token.
Parameter beneficiary_ is only used by the constructor to initialize _beneficiary.
Parameter releaseStartTime_ is only used by the constructor for release time state.
Parameter daysOfTimelock_ is only used by the constructor to compute _releaseEndTime.
Parameter totalBenefit_ is only used by the constructor to initialize _totalBenefit.
Parameter newOwner flows directly into _setOwner, the core function that mutates ownership.
Local amount is computed in withdraw() and consumed directly by the safeTransfer unsafe operation.
Local passedDays is an intermediate of releasedBalance() day math.
Local totalDays is an intermediate of releasedBalance() day math.
Local amountToWithdraw is computed in terminate() and consumed directly by the safeTransfer unsafe operation.
Local oldOwner is a transient cache inside _setOwner used only for the ownership-change event.
